format: UTF-8; simplified Chinese TAB French; one term per line; unique sorted keys
license: GPL-3.0-or-later for project additions; upstream Rime Ice and Qingjian sources under GPLv3; see LICENSE.txt

sources.name: Qingjian English glossary; Chinese-key membership only, no English definitions translated

selection: Static preferred everyday terms that already occur in a source; top 300 single Han characters by weight; then 2-6 Han-character Rime Ice base terms by descending weight, lexical ties. Deduplicate and keep first 5000.

translation.engine: Apple public Translation framework; installed on-device zh-Hans to fr model
translation.human_review: Common-word spot checks only; machine translation may be ambiguous without context

privacy: Built exclusively from the listed static source dictionaries. No learned vocabulary, input history, user database, or user sentence was read to create the asset.
